import collections,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
for path in map(Path,sys.argv[1:]):
 rows=[json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
 for action in ("run","pass","fail","skip"):
  names=collections.Counter(row["Test"] for row in rows if row.get("Action")==action and row.get("Test","").startswith("TestIdentity") and "/" not in row["Test"])
  print(action,dict(sorted(names.items())))
 print("subtest executions:",sum(row.get("Action")=="run" and "/" in row.get("Test","") for row in rows))
 print("package completion:",[(row.get("Action"),row.get("Package")) for row in rows if "Test" not in row and row.get("Action") in ("pass","fail","skip")])
